title: 第29章 这家伙竟然说要考虑
novel_title: 我被师姐凌辱，你说我罪恶滔天？
content_zh:
“沈长老居然要收陈默为徒，我没听错吧。”

    “没听错我也听到了，确实是沈长老亲口说的。”

    “这个陈默走了什么狗屎运，一个外门弟子直接被内门长老看中了。”

    台下的外门弟子们炸开了锅，每个人的脸上都写满了震惊和羡慕。

    当陆瑶站在擂台边上听到这些话之后脸色变得极其难看，她的手紧紧攥着衣角满脸震惊。

    此时她在心里想着陈默那个废物凭什么，他有什么资格被内门长老看中。

    之前不过是一个练气一层的废物，不过是侥幸赢了几场比试而已。

    凭什么他能拜入沈长老门下，凭什么。

    这时陆瑶的眼中也充满了嫉妒和不甘，她的嘴唇都在发抖。

    只见周玄站在人群中脸上露出了激动的笑容，他在心里想着陈默这下真的发达了。

    内门长老亲自开口要收他为徒，以后在外门还有谁敢动他？

    当周玄转过头看着陆瑶便故意提高了声音，他就是要让陆瑶听到。

    “哎呀有些人刚才还在说陈默死定了，现在怎么样人家要被内门长老收为徒弟了。”周玄说道。

    “不像某些人的哥哥服用了爆元丹还被陈默一招打败，现在躺在地上跟狗一样。”

    “你说什么。”陆瑶转过头盯着周玄眼中全是怒火。

    “我说什么你心里清楚。”周玄说道。

    “刚才你不是挺得意的吗，现在怎么不说话了。”

    “你……”陆瑶气得浑身发抖可又说不出反驳的话来。

    然而周玄没有再理她而是转过头看着擂台上的陈默，他的心中充满了激动和兴奋。

    看来陈默这下真的翻身了，从今以后再也没有人敢叫他废物了。

    擂台之上陈默站在那里看着沈清璇，他的脸上带着几分意外。

    这个女人居然要收他为徒倒是没想到。

    “陈默你听到了吗，沈长老要收你为徒。”鹤阳真人说道。

    “还不快谢过沈长老。”

    然而陈默看了鹤阳真人一眼然后转过头看着沈清璇，他没有急着说话而是在心里想了想。

    只见沈清璇站在擂台上看着陈默，她的脸上没有什么表情眼神而且异常的平静。

    “你跟本座走吧，从今天起你就是本座的弟子了。”沈清璇说道。

    “内门的修炼资源比外门多得多，你的天赋在外门浪费了。”

    这时的陈默他看着沈清璇沉默了片刻，然后开口说了一句话。

    “我考虑一下。”
content_en:
"Elder Shen actually wants to accept Chen Mo as his disciple. Did I hear that right?"

    "I heard that right. It was indeed said by Elder Shen himself."

    "What kind of bad luck did this Chen Mo have? An outer disciple was directly spotted by an inner disciple."

    The outer disciples in the audience exploded, with shock and envy written all over their faces.

    When Lu Yao stood at the edge of the ring and heard these words, her face became extremely ugly. Her hands were tightly clenching the corners of her clothes and her face was filled with shock.

    At this time, she was thinking in her mind about Chen Mo, that good-for-nothing, and what qualifications he had to be favored by the elders of the inner sect.

    Before, he was just a waste at the first level of Qi training, and he just won a few competitions by luck.

    Why can he become the disciple of Elder Shen? Why?

    At this time, Lu Yao's eyes were full of jealousy and unwillingness, and her lips were trembling.

    Zhou Xuan was seen standing in the crowd with an excited smile on his face. He was thinking that Chen Mo was really prosperous now.

    The elder of the inner sect personally asked to accept him as a disciple. Who else in the outer sect would dare to touch him in the future?

    When Zhou Xuan turned his head to look at Lu Yao, he deliberately raised his voice so that Lu Yao could hear him.

    "Oh, some people were saying that Chen Mo was dead just now. Now, he will be accepted as a disciple by the elders of the inner sect." Zhou Xuan said.

    "It's not like some people's brother who took the Baoyuan Dan and was defeated by Chen Mo with one move. Now he's lying on the ground like a dog."

    "What did you say?" Lu Yao turned her head and stared at Zhou Xuan with anger in her eyes.

    "You know what I said." Zhou Xuan said.

    "Weren't you very proud just now? Why are you silent now?"

    "You..." Lu Yao was so angry that she was shaking all over, but she couldn't say anything to refute.

    However, Zhou Xuan ignored her and turned to look at Chen Mo on the ring. His heart was filled with excitement.

    It seems that Chen Mo has really turned around now. From now on, no one will dare to call him a waste.

    On the stage, Chen Mo stood there and looked at Shen Qingxuan, with a bit of surprise on his face.

    He didn't expect that this woman would actually accept him as her disciple.

    "Chen Mo, did you hear that Elder Shen wants to accept you as his disciple?" Master Heyang said.

    "Why don't you thank Elder Shen quickly?"

    However, Chen Mo glanced at Master Heyang and then turned to look at Shen Qingxuan. He did not speak in a hurry but thought about it in his heart.

    Shen Qingxuan was seen standing on the ring looking at Chen Mo, her face expressionless and unusually calm.

    "You come with me. From today on, you are my disciple." Shen Qingxuan said.

    "The inner sect has much more training resources than the outer sect. Your talent is wasted in the outer sect."

    At this time, Chen Mo looked at Shen Qingxuan in silence for a moment, and then said something.

    "I'll think about it."
title_en: Chapter 29 This guy actually said he would consider it
